necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation associated with diagnosis code I48.0. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances. This service is necessary to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management in the setting of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73).
